Venue: Gate
Headline: Gate Upgrades Event Points System: Integrating Event Contracts Trading into Rewards

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
To enhance the event trading experience and expand user rewards, Gate Event Contracts are now officially integrated into the Event Points system. Users who complete eligible Event Contracts trades can earn Scratch Cards based on their valid trading volume, unlocking multiple rewards including USDT, Event Points, and Trading Trial Vouchers, while also gaining opportunities to compete for weekly Event Points Leaderboard rewards and the Super Lucky Pool.
The Gate Event Points system combines event trading with points-based incentives through a “trade to earn cards, scratch to win, and climb the leaderboard” mechanism. Following this upgrade, Event Contracts trading is now included in the Event Points Campaign. Users can accumulate valid trading volume through eligible trades and automatically receive Scratch Cards, with no additional registration required. For every 20 USDT in Event Contracts trading, users can receive 1 Scratch Card. Specific eligibility criteria are subject to the rules on the campaign page.
In terms of the rewards mechanism, each valid Scratch Card unlocks one reward, including 1–100 USDT in cash rewards, 1–88,888 PTS in Event Points, 5–100 USDT in Trading Trial Vouchers, iPhone Duo, and other surprise rewards. Users also have a chance to win the Super Lucky Prize, receiving 88,888 PTS in a single draw and becoming eligible to share the current Super Lucky Pool. Event Points earned will automatically count toward the current ranking period and can be used to compete on the Event Points Leaderboard.
The Event Points Campaign operates on weekly ranking periods. Every Monday at 10:00 (UTC), the previous period is settled and a new period begins. The Top 100 users on each Event Points Leaderboard can share the Event Points prize pool based on their final rankings, with the top-ranked user eligible to receive up to 37.5% of the pool. After each settlement, Event Points from the completed period are automatically reset, while unused Scratch Cards from that period expire. Users can continue participating in the new ranking period.
For each period, Gate contributes a fixed 10,000 USDT to the prize pool, with an additional 0.1 USDT added for every Scratch Card successfully scratched. Of the prize pool allocation for each period, 80% goes to Event Points Leaderboard rewards and 20% to the Super Lucky Pool. If no user wins the Super Lucky Prize during a given period, the Super Lucky Pool automatically rolls over to the next period and continues to accumulate, creating additional reward opportunities for participants.
By adding Event Contracts trading to the Event Points system, Gate is further expanding the coverage of its event trading incentives and connecting more trading scenarios with points-based rewards. Looking ahead, Gate will continue to enhance the functionality of its Prediction Markets and Event Contracts products, optimize its points rewards and participation mechanisms, and build a richer and more diverse event trading ecosystem.
